THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA
AT SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated, Shillong the qd November, 2026
No. HCM.I1/111/2021/Pt-ll/Estt/ qUI'1 : in supersession of this Registry’s Notification
No HCM.I1/111/2021/Pt-11/962Adated 12th April, 2023, Hon’ble the Chief Justice is
pleased to reconstitute the FASTER Unit for the High Court of Meghalaya comprising
of the following members:
i. Joint Registrar (Listing);
ii. Deputy Registrar (Judicial)
iii. Superintendent (Judicial);
iv. Shri Don Marshyllong, System Analyst;
v. Smti Monica Shallam, Junior Administrative Assistant
vi. Shri Evangelis Momin, Junior Administrative Assistant.
REGISTRAR GENERAL
